name: Can I use chemical drain cleaners for standing water?

mainEntity.name: Can I use chemical drain cleaners for standing water?

acceptedAnswer.text: While chemical drain cleaners are readily available, we generally advise against using them. They often contain harsh chemicals that can corrode pipes, especially older ones, and may not fully clear the obstruction. Furthermore, if the cleaner doesn't work, the standing water mixed with chemicals becomes a hazardous material for plumbers to deal with. Professional methods are safer and more effective for clearing clogs.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's not recommended to use chemical drain cleaners as they can damage pipes and create hazardous conditions. Professional methods are safer and more effective.
